card.title: Milestone

import.description: Choose an archive exported from a milestone (up to 100 MB). The import creates the milestone exercise with its template, solution and test repositories, the milestone group, its user stories and its other exercises (quiz, text, modeling and file upload exercises).

import.keepDates: Keep the dates of the exported milestone
import.notAMilestoneArchive: The selected file is not a milestone archive.

export.description: Choose the milestone to export. The archive contains the milestone exercise with its repositories and all exercises of its group, and can be imported into any course.
